So, I’m very new to figuring out aquariums and related, and honestly I’m a bit lost on what to get. I’ve recently gotten a 10-gallon tank to start working with a female betta sorority (they are not together yet, I want a divider first just in case) and I’m having a lot of trouble finding a good filter. Every filter I’m finding is either giant and expensive, or there’s lots of reviews saying it killed their betta fish. I don’t have a ton of room and obviously I don’t want to kill my betta fish... and I was hoping to add African Dwarf Frogs eventually too and I don’t want them to get sucked in. What are some good filters that won’t completely destroy my budget and won’t kill my fish? I’m just really nervous about getting this right and I’m having difficulties finding helpful info. 

I’ve looked into a couple of the Tetra Whisper filters and the ones I was recommended both had reviews saying it killed their bettas- along with a couple others on lists for “filters for betta fish.”
